changes: Replace separate count-only and metadata-backed work-unit split loops with one shared implementation.
Admit work-unit result arrays and slots, mutable range scratch, descriptor construction and detached task payloads.
Preserve complete task fields, including window plans, while detaching mutable predicate, projection, partition and range state.
Plain planning transfers output ownership to the caller at return; in-flight reservations release on success and failure.

edge_cases: metadata-free split on a nonexistent path proves no file access
peak-minus-one budget rejects and returns to zero
mutable caller projection/partition changes do not affect output
window plan preservation and independent ownership
real Parquet row-limit planning and indivisible-group rejection
validation.typecheck: passed before final window-plan test assertions; production code unchanged

tradeoffs: Deep detachment adds copy work and conservatively charges repeated immutable task payloads per output; no new throughput claim.
remaining: Generic aggregate-task grouping still uses separate unadmitted topology helpers.
Borrowed-store metadata can allocate externally before retained-copy admission.
Returned plain task arrays leave library accounting at return; there is not yet an owned planning result API.
Full current-revision release gates and broader mixed-job acceptance remain open.
